page.overview:
Who is Charming Man?

He wields the Stand Bigmouth Strikes Again which allows him to turn his body into small sand-rock particles, allowing him to blend in with the environment, change his appearance allowing him to disguise himself into other people and go into people's bodies

Charming Man is a man of above average height and a more muscular build. He has noticeable black tattoos under his eyes.

Charming man has a very mistrusting and rough personality similar to Abbacchio from part 5. he usually picks on and looks down on his fellow teammate Usagi Aloha'oe even proposing to leave him behind when he is attacked by an enemy stand showing that he sees him as useless and willing to let him die and not believing him when he says he's being attacked. He also shows a willingness to give up quickly and trying to convince other to give up such as him quickly trying to talk to the police about his brother's disappearance, telling Jodio to give the lava rock quickly while disguised as Paco and telling Dragona to give up on Usagi while he's getting attacked

Charming Man's Stand Bigmouth Strikes Again allows him to break himself apart into small sand like specs and can reform them to blend into his surroundings as well as attaching himself to things and mimicking them.
